title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
author: Lucas Maes; Quentin Le Lidec; Damien Scieur; Yann LeCun; Randall Balestriero
summary: LeWorldModel (LeWM) is a new method that learns compact, stable world models from raw pixel data without using rewards or reconstruction losses. It uses an encoder to map images into a latent space and a predictor to forecast future states based on actions. This approach helps plan and understand environment dynamics in a simple, task-agnostic way.
